create_densecl_hook: create a DenseCLHook instance with custom start_iters for loss_lambda warmup
use_densecl_before_train: use the before_train method to obtain loss_lambda from the DenseCL algorithm
use_densecl_before_train_iter: use the before_train_iter method to adjust loss_lambda each training iteration
register_densecl_hook: register the DenseCLHook module in the HOOKS registry for mmpretrain training runs
configure_densecl_warmup: configure DenseCL loss_lambda warmup by setting start_iters to delay non-zero loss
